title.narrative: Development of a GCF Concept Note for Masen's Offshore Wind Pilot Project in Morocco

description.narrative: This project aims to develop a concept note to be submitted to the Green Climate Fund (GCF) for a scalable offshore wind farm along Morocco's Atlantic coast. The initial phase of the project will target a capacity of 750MW, with the potential to increase to 1GW based on the outcomes of the feasibility study. The project will demonstrate its technical and economic feasibility while assessing the competitiveness of offshore wind power as a sustainable energy solution for Morocco in the short to medium term.
